scope: Research-only design decision for W7. It resolves blockers B003, B004, B005, B007, and B008 without creating production actions, graph records, account-state fields, routes, scores, commits, or pushes.

included: account-state, action-runtime, schema, graph, and test compatibility analysis
a factual action and observation contract
verified behavior-level aliases and explicit non-aliases

blocker_decisions.decision: Keep account_state.diary_tiers as the sole authoritative, externally player-confirmed highest-claimed-tier snapshot. W7 must not derive, set, or advance a diary tier from task milestones.
rationale: The evaluator and dependency analyzer already treat diary_tier_at_least as an external input when no explicit producer exists.
A player may import a valid diary claim without having recorded every individual task in this project.
Task completion and the in-game tier-claim interaction are distinct events; deriving one from incomplete local task records would be false certainty.

allowed_existing_transition.permitted_only_for: a deliberately invoked player-confirmed import or record action outside generated diary task actions
allowed_existing_transition.required_rule: may only advance a canonical region tier and may never downgrade it

blocker_decisions.prohibited_w7_transition: No generated diary task action or task-milestone action may use set_diary_tier, create a claimed-tier milestone, award a tier reward, or create a lamp entitlement.
blocker_decisions.reward_rule: Existing reward-claim actions continue to require diary_tier_at_least. They may claim the current-tier item or durable capability after the externally confirmed tier exists, but must not infer the tier or select a lamp recipient.

blocker_decisions.decision: Use the existing verified action kind activity for a curated deterministic diary task. Do not add a diary_task kind.

task_action_contract.completion: one milestone predicate using the state_milestone_key_pattern
task_action_contract.outcomes: one milestone outcome using the state_milestone_key_pattern
task_action_contract.required_effect: one set_add effect to milestones using the state_milestone_key_pattern
task_action_contract.fact_link: one or more verified production fact IDs; a research package ID alone is insufficient

allowed_preconditions: skill_at_least when the source has an exact level and a normal level gate is sufficient
quest_completed for an exact completed-quest gate
milestone or transport_flag only when the referenced canonical producer already exists
item_at_least or resource_at_least for an exact known quantity
counter_at_least only for an existing durable counter with a sourced exact threshold
an explicit any group for a fully specified alternative, including a separately player-confirmed temporary-boost milestone
allowed_effects: delta for exact deterministic item or resource consumption or creation
gain_xp only for a sourced, guaranteed integer award
reported_effects for fractional XP, player-selected XP, variable outputs, and recorded progress
prohibited_effects: set_diary_tier in a generated diary task action
a random drop, loot roll, fish, ore, crop yield, monster kill, collection-log entry, minigame point award, or daily reset
a charge, cooldown, team result, staged sequence, or location state that lacks a dedicated exact model
a task output whose amount, retention, or success is conditional on an observation

required: Add diary_tier_at_least to data/schemas/progression-action.schema.json with a canonical region key and one of none, easy, medium, hard, or elite as its value.

Add the already-runtime-supported set_diary_tier effect to data/schemas/progression-action.schema.json with state diary_tiers, a canonical region key, and one of none, easy, medium, hard, or elite as its value.

Keep scripts/apply_action.py, scripts/evaluate_progression.py, scripts/analyze_dependencies.py, and scripts/validate_data.py behaviorally aligned with that schema; their current runtime rules are the reference behavior.
not_required: A generic effect that mutates arbitrary observations
A claim action generated from task milestones

blocker_decisions.decision: Use only behavior-level one-to-one aliases. Preserve non-one-to-one descriptions as references, not aliases.

verified_aliases.equivalence: Both claim the current Ardougne cloak after an externally confirmed eligible Ardougne tier; neither claims the tier or a lamp.
Both are the unlimited Ardougne-cloak monastery teleport and consume no charge or daily use.
Both consume one observed Digsite-pendant charge to teleport to the Digsite; enchantment and pendant creation remain separate actions.

explicit_non_aliases.reason: This names a set of distinct counter-producing and reward-claim actions, not one behavior. Keep varrock-museum-kudos-paths and its action set canonical.
Production deliberately separates enchantment knowledge, spell creation, and tablet creation. Mapping this label to one action would erase a material alternative.

explicit_non_aliases.package_reference: balloon travel actions for the Varrock diary task
explicit_non_aliases.reason: The task requires a journey from Varrock, while action:balloon-trip-varrock is a journey to Varrock. Direction and consumed logs are material.

blocker_decisions.decision: Do not make an observation an action requirement or graph producer. Reuse existing strict snapshots where they fit, and introduce one future diary_task_observations field only when a player-import workflow needs to preserve a task-specific external completion record.

existing_observation_ownership.recording_rule: Use a task-specific encounter key only to record attempts, confirmed completions, supplies, deaths, and elapsed time. It never establishes readiness, future throughput, loot, extraction, or a diary task milestone.

existing_observation_ownership.boundary: RNG items, drops, and collection log
existing_observation_ownership.recording_rule: Keep possession, log confirmation, quantity, variant, charges, condition, usability, and reclaimability separate. An RNG source may have a makes_obtainable graph edge but never a produces edge.

existing_observation_ownership.boundary: crop, patch, Hespori, and anima state
existing_observation_ownership.recording_rule: Use the existing patch, disease, protection, growth, harvest-life, and readiness snapshot. Do not advance time, infer a grown crop, or infer harvest quantity.

existing_observation_ownership.boundary: daily use, cooldown, and recurring availability
existing_observation_ownership.recording_rule: Use state, observed_at, and ready_at only as a player snapshot. A capability is not a free repeatable action and an observation does not advance its timer.

existing_observation_ownership.owner: unique_item_observations, kourend_memoir, or the existing dedicated charged-item action model
existing_observation_ownership.recording_rule: Use exact charge transitions only where a dedicated model already owns the item. Otherwise record a nullable charge observation and do not decrement it from a diary task.

existing_observation_ownership.boundary: team activity, points, credit, and role-dependent completion
existing_observation_ownership.recording_rule: Pest Control, Barbarian Assault, raids, and comparable team tasks stay observation-only until a task-specific imported record is needed. Do not synthesize a team, role, activity meter, credit, or reward from account stats.

future_single_field_contract.when_to_add: Only when importing a player-confirmed diary-task record is a real user workflow. Do not add it merely to unblock generated actions.

common_fields.mode: combat, rng, crop, daily, charge, team, or staged

future_single_field_contract.validation_rule: Each mode is a closed object: it has the common fields and exactly its declared payload fields. Unknown is represented with null only where the individual field is nullable; additional properties are rejected.
future_single_field_contract.non_implication_rule: Neither a completed observation nor any payload member changes inventory, counters, collection log, diary_tiers, completed_actions, milestones, graph reachability, or action eligibility.

blocker_decisions.decision: Retain the Wilderness elite boss-family task as player-confirmed, non-generated research in W7. Do not model Callisto/Artio, Venenatis/Spindel, and Vet'ion/Calvar'ion as independent durable task milestones.

task.reset_condition: Completing or updating any other diary task before the final qualifying family kill resets the staged progress.

future_observation_instance.completed_stage_ids: unique subset of stage_ids in observed order
future_observation_instance.completion_rule: Only a player-confirmed in-game completion can set status completed. The model never infers completion from three boss kill observations.

task_execution_inventory.decision: Only already-curated, behavior-verified task actions are executable now. Raw deterministic wording in a research task is not sufficient: the action must also have typed preconditions, exact input fate, a verified production fact link, and a bounded deterministic transition.

executable_now.reason: Existing action has exact spell unlock, spellbook, boost alternative, rune inputs, one-bone transition, and a dedicated completion milestone. Fractional Magic XP is reported rather than fabricated.
Existing action has exact quest, spellbook, boost alternative, three-rune cost, integer XP, and a dedicated completion milestone.
Existing action models the exact charged-talisman and mounted-talisman alternatives without inventing talisman acquisition or a charge.

observation_only_now.membership_rule: Every task in the twelve-region, 488-task inventory other than the three executable_now canonical task keys remains observation-only in W7.
observation_only_now.reason: No bulk action generation. The remaining records include either a player-confirmed success boundary, an RNG or variable output, crop/daily/charge/team/staged state, an untyped in-game gate, an incomplete input-fate contract, catalog-only source provenance, or an existing canonical system that must not be duplicated.

promotion_requirements: The exact task has an authoritative task-level source reference or a documented production-grade source inheritance rule approved for actions.
Every hard requirement is expressible by an existing typed predicate or an explicit, separately confirmed boundary.
Every consumed input has an exact item or resource key and quantity, including a selected alternative where relevant.
The action has no variable success, output, retention, team, timer, charge, or staged-progress dependency unless its dedicated state model is complete and tested.
The action produces only its own milestone plus exact deterministic effects and cites a verified production fact record.
A behavior-level alias check confirms it does not duplicate a current action.

graph_contract.state_to_graph_rule: The account milestone stores diary-task:<region_slug>:<source_task_id>; the graph node adds only the milestone: prefix. This follows the existing action-state versus graph-node naming convention.
allowed_edges: A typed prerequisite node to a curated task activity uses requires.
A curated deterministic task activity to its own task milestone uses produces.
An externally confirmed diary-tier condition to an existing reward-claim action or capability uses requires or unlocks as appropriate.
An RNG activity to an item or collection-log possibility uses makes_obtainable only.
A fully verified alternate input or access method uses alternative or bypass only when it satisfies the same bounded condition.
forbidden_edges: Any individual task milestone to a diary-tier condition or a diary reward.
An observation node or observation payload to an action, milestone, item, counter, tier, or capability.
A boss kill, crop, team result, daily state, charge state, or staged substep to an item, completion, or tier when its result is observed or variable.
A random activity to a guaranteed inventory or collection-log node with produces.

account_state: Do not replace, rename, or derive account_state.diary_tiers. Existing snapshots with a confirmed tier remain valid even when no diary task milestones are present.
Do not add diary task milestones retroactively from diary_tiers, completed_actions, quest lists, gear, counters, or inventory.

If the future diary_task_observations field is introduced, make it required in the strict account schema only with an empty-object default added together to graph/account-state.example.json and every fixture. Existing snapshots migrate by adding an empty object; no observation is inferred.
actions: Keep the three listed existing task action IDs and milestone keys stable; do not rename them to the proposed generic pattern.
Do not add compatibility alias actions. Store aliases in research metadata and have future validators resolve package references before checking for duplicates.
Existing diary reward-claim actions remain backward compatible because they continue to consume only externally confirmed diary_tiers and their current item/capability rules.
graphs: Do not add 488 placeholder activity or milestone nodes in W7.
When a future curated task action is added, add its action node, milestone node, and only the edges justified by its own typed action contract.

decision_file_checks: The inventory equals 488 tasks: 134 easy, 152 medium, 125 hard, and 77 elite.
executable_now has exactly three unique canonical task keys and three unique canonical action IDs.
observation_only_now total is 485 and its region counts sum to 485.
The executable and observation-only sets are disjoint and sum to 488.
Every verified alias target exists in data/progression/actions.json.
ASCII only and no trailing whitespace.
focused_w7_tests: test_apply_action: an explicit set_diary_tier record may advance a confirmed claim and rejects a downgrade.
test_apply_action: the three existing diary task actions retain exact inputs, options, and task milestones without changing diary_tiers.
test_analyze_dependencies: diary_tier_at_least remains an external input with no modeled producer.
test_analyze_dependencies: a diary task milestone does not produce a diary tier, lamp, or reward claim.
test_validate_diary_packages: retain the twelve-package, 488-task inventory assertion and validate the three decision action mappings.

unresolved_facts_and_deferred_work.detail: Catalog inheritance is sufficient for regional factual records but not a per-task executable action. Nine packages remain catalog-inheritance packages.
The 485 observation-only tasks need individually normalized item/resource keys, alternatives, exact output fate, and typed preconditions before promotion.
The future closed diary_task_observations field is specified here but is not needed for W7's schema alignment and must not be added until imported task-completion records are an active user workflow.
No current source or account snapshot establishes team composition, role performance, instance result, or staged sequence state automatically.

summary: W7 should align the action schema with the already-tested diary-tier runtime, preserve diary tiers as external player-confirmed claims, retain only the three existing curated diary-task actions, resolve three behavior-level references, and deliberately leave all other regional task records observation-only.
